item: A settings repair is shown once, visibly, until dismissed
key_paths: src/scheduler/settings.py src/api/scheduler.py src/static/app-sources.js src/static/index.html src/static/locales tests/test_settings_repair_notice.py
summary: A save that rebuilt unreadable scheduler settings said what it reset only in its one response and the log. It now persists repair_notice {at, reset, written_off}, carried by GET /api/scheduler/config, drawn as a visible line in Settings > Advanced > Collection (editions and budget back at defaults, switches turned off so the repair started nothing online, a paused Wikipedia lane, a count of other settings) and toasted once per repair per device at boot or after the speed knob's save. Text built from field names and fixed keys, 13 strings x12. Dismiss only, naming the notice's at, so a stale panel or the repairing save itself cannot clear a newer notice (review must-fix).
